record.title: Publish the post-checkpoint alpha.3 distributions
record.intent: Expose the proved corrections as a new immutable native/JVM consumer release with accurate compatibility notes.
requirements: Use clean exact source and matching three-platform native/JVM corpus, packaged parity, bootstrap and provenance inputs. Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and all old release bytes.

Publish 0.3.0-alpha.3 only after real GitHub draft transport checks pass. Generated locks prefer native and retain an explicit JVM reference; no protocol semantics, implicit state rewrite or consumer migration is introduced.
Keep experimental kernel/IDL dependencies outside the CLI artifacts. Notes distinguish newly available alpha envelopes from the unfrozen v1 candidate.
acceptance: Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64 and macOS aarch64 pass native/JVM behavioral and process parity, clean bootstrap and offline cached operation against the exact release artifacts.
The immutable published release, source tag, checksums, implementation/build identities, locks and signed release asset attestations agree. No unexecuted signature or SLSA claim is made.
